rationale: The claim accurately reflects the limitations of the inspected sources. While the artifact notes the vendor page contains a feature list mentioning 'FAA TSO authorization', it also uses 'on track' language. This internal marketing ambiguity, combined with the lack of a primary FAA DRS record, means the public pages do not authoritatively establish issuance. The 2022 FAA/GA-ASI document is correctly classified as a research deliverable rather than an approval.
limitations: Absence of evidence on a vendor page is not proof of non-issuance; a definitive conclusion requires retrieving the actual article-specific authorization letters from the FAA DRS.
